summary.text: Justin Thurber is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Bristol District since January 2025 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Thurber took office on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026. He faces Democrat Jamison Souza in the general election.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Global Warming and Climate Change Committee, the House Committee on Intergovernmental Affairs and the Public Health Joint Committee, and served as ranking minority member of the Community Development and Small Businesses and the Veterans and Federal Affairs joint committees.
